Subject: Exec ally MAP kickoff — VP/CTO introductions & evaluation plan

Hi Alice / Jason —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and make sure we hit the Q2 timelines we discussed, I pulled together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an evaluation checklist focused on performance, integration, and security evidence. I attached the first-draft MAP and a lightweight timeline worksheet.

High-level ask: can you confirm an executive sponsor (VP/CTO equivalent) who can be the escalation path for scope or SLA decisions? That'll help us coordinate procurement + engineering signoffs and keep the exec review aligned to your quarter goals.

Proposed outcomes for the quarter:
- Exec-level alignment on success criteria (cost per 1k tokens; p95 latency targets)
- Technical evaluation completed (benchmarks + integration PoC)
- Security/compliance evidence shared (SOC2, retention controls)
- Decision point: purchase order or pilot extension by the end of Q2

Proposed roles (please adjust):
- Exec Sponsor: Acme VP/CTO (we ask for one named contact)
- Redwood Exec Sponsor: Grace O'Connor (me) — escalation/strategy
- Technical Lead: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — benchmarking & PoC ops
- CS Lead: Priyom Das (Redwood) — onboarding & adoption

Next steps:
1) Reply with exec sponsor name + best contact email
2) Confirm 60 and 90 minute slots next week for MAP kickoff + tech deep-dive (calendar links below)
3) If procurement needs an initial SOW/quote, Lindsey from your team can be looped in — we can draft a redline-friendly SOW in 48 hours once sponsors are confirmed

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-Acme-v1.pdf (MAP draft), MAP-timeline-sheet.xlsx (week-by-week milestones)
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/r/Acme-Map-2028
Calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/meeting/8a7f-4c2d-map-kickoff

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on owners and a clear 8‑12 week plan.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Exec ally MAP kickoff — VP/CTO introductions & evaluation plan

Grace — thanks for the clear plan and materials. Appreciate the timeline.

Quick answers: we are happy to name our VP of Engineering, Jason Park, as executive sponsor for this evaluation. Jason will own exec escalation and will join the kickoff for the initial 30 minutes to confirm outcomes. Lindsey Chen (procurement) is cc'ed here — she will be our point for SOW and PO discussions.

On security evidence: we will need SOC 2 Type II and a sketch of data retention/audit log behavior for the pilot. Can Redwood share the evidence bundle and a short note about private deployment options (VPC/KMS)? If you can attach the SOC2 summary and IP/data boundary doc that would be ideal.

Availability: Jason can join Wed Apr 19 between 13:00-15:00 PT or Thu Apr 20 10:00-11:30 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Alice Ng
CTO, Acme Systems
alice.ng@acmesystems.com

On Tue, Apr 18, 2028 at 9:15 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> High-level ask: can you confirm an executive sponsor...

I can run the technical evaluation and own the bench. My proposed checklist for the PoC:
- Baseline: perf vs. your existing provider (p50/p90/p95 latency, tokens/sec)
- Integration: API latency under realistic prompt mixes, streaming perf
- Cost model: token-level cost comparison + batching/caching plan
- Security: paper trail on retention/KMS; confirm no external logging for pilot

I'll prepare a short benchmark harness and a sample prompt set that mirrors your workload. If Jason confirms the kickoff window (Wed 13:00 PT works for me) I'll schedule the deep-dive right after the executive alignment.

Attachment: exec-sponsor-roster.docx (internal note with escalation contacts)
